text:
taylor: Quick clarifying question from the all-hands Q&A: is the autoscaler going to prefer keeping model count stable or keeping latency stable when capacity is tight? Product needs the behavior documented.

sophia: Preference order: 1) maintain latency SLO for customer-facing routes where possible, 2) conserve capacity by batching and preferring quantized variants for internal/low-priority routes, 3) scale down non-critical warm pools. We'll expose policy toggles.

liam: Can we get examples of the toggles? I want to use them in integration tests.

sophia: Example toggles: "latency_priority": true/false, "max_cross_region_latency_ms": 200, "allow_quantized_fallback": true/false. We'll publish a policy schema in the docs.

maria: Also a question on comms: what should support say to customers if they notice degraded p95?

lisa: Suggested script for support: short explanation + link to status page + ETA for mitigation. I'll draft an FAQ snippet.

capacity-bot: New procurement alert: vendor B reported a 2-week shipment delay for next batch. Impact: APAC pilot buffer reduced by ~10%.

liam: Noted. For tests: can infra provide a mock policy JSON so we can run e2e?

sophia: I'll upload a sample policy JSON to the docs repo and tag you.

maria: Thanks. Request: can we consolidate all action items and owners into a single doc? I'd like one place for comms to check.
